result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. I checked it by running the CLI: `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` created `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`, and `-help` printed its own usage. I did not run the Maven test suite, since the CLI module has no tests of its own.

Changes:
- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description (landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`), and listed it in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to `updateLandscape`, which now takes the command name and description so `-help` prints the name the user typed. `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions and never mentioned `updateLandscape`, so I added a short "Landscape" section with the `analyzeLandscape` example and a note that `updateLandscape` still works.

Nothing is committed. The `.claude/` directory was already untracked before I started.
